purpose: One further bounded Development extension after Stage 13 lambda=16 boundary winner, plus matched three-seed no-Fisher ablation. Prior Development exposure is explicit; this is not an untouched holdout or proof of correct curvature.
invariants: Original 200-step full-state AdamW recursion, unscaled deletion sources, fixed L8/L4M4 requests and Development/Dev-Select rows, same utility guards and equal-scenario mean E_U. Historical code/results stay read-only. No FinalTest.

coarse.reproduction: At each phase reproduce lambda=1 and 16 against Stage 13 E_U/D_U/AUC/logloss within max(1e-8,0.001*abs(old)), plus the formal-adapter lambda=1 gate. Reproduce seed-42 lambda=0 against its frozen historical row before merging. Lambda=0 is a no-feedback ablation, not a scaled deletion source.

selection: Both requests must satisfy AUC damage<=0.005, logloss damage<=0.01 and no prediction collapse. Minimize equal-scenario mean E_U; ties nearest 1 then candidate ID. Merge unchanged historical Stage 13 rows with new >16 candidates; rerun controls and ablation are not duplicated in selection.

budget_gate.reference: Frozen seed-42 Stage 13 lambda=16 equal-scenario mean E_U
budget_gate.rule: Both must pass. Engineering continuation thresholds, not significance or a universal scientific-materiality criterion.

fine.trigger: Coarse winner is 32 or 64 and passes the budget gate.
fine.grid_rule: 32 -> [24,48]; 64 -> [48,96]. Freeze before execution; run the two arithmetic midpoints once with controls 1/16.

stopping: Hard cap 128: a winner there remains an unresolved boundary optimum; no automatic expansion.
No fine scan for a boundary winner or insufficient gain. No additional fine round.
If final screen winner is >16 and passes the budget gate, freeze it for confirmation; otherwise retain 16 as the ablation/reference target and do not rerun a new >16 winner on confirmation seeds.
Even if search stops or confirmation fails, report all outcomes and complete the no-Fisher ablation.

confirmation_and_ablation.conditional_run: Frozen >16 winner only if the screen passes the budget gate; never reselect on these seeds.
confirmation_and_ablation.confirmation_pass: Winner and lambda=16 reference utility-eligible/non-collapsed in both requests; all winner residuals<1; mean E_U strictly below lambda=16 separately in each seed. Report every individual cell regression. Lambda=0 is not an eligibility gate for this tuning comparison.
confirmation_and_ablation.ablation: Use fresh seed-42 coarse lambda=0 and fresh seeds41/43 lambda=0. Report paired E_U/residual/utility/Toward-Exact differences to lambda=16 and, if triggered, the fixed final winner, for all three seeds and all six request cells. Preserve target failures; never silently substitute 16 for a failed winner. Zero denominators yield null relative gains. These are descriptive comparisons, not significance tests.
confirmation_and_ablation.no_new_winner: Still run 0/1/16 on 41/43 and report three-seed 0-vs-16 ablation; confirmation status is not triggered, not failed.

diagnostics: Retain endpoint parameter-update norm, cosine and relative L2 to Exact-Masked for every finite candidate. These are diagnostic-only, not selection inputs or privacy guarantees.
failures: Known nonfinite/singular tangent errors invalidate new candidates and are retained. Nonfinite cross-seed lambda=0 is a failed ablation row. Failures of lambda=1/16 controls, seed42 lambda0 reproduction, IO, OOM, software or integrity abort the affected cell. No clipping, rescue tuning, overwrite, or automatic FinalTest authorization.
